en:
<CLT=cltMIND>If implicating Himiko was the plan, then
disrupting that plan might teach us something.
<CLT=cltMIND>For that reason...I have to lie!

Tsumugi is correct. I believe Himiko
was being <CLT=cltSTRONG>set up<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Himiko only picked that room because Kiyo
wanted it <CLT=cltSTRONG>as dark as possible<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

No...in order for The Caged Child to succeed, 
the room must be as dark as possible.

My lab has windows, so even with the
lights off, it is still not dark enough.
Then...what about the empty rooms?

Even if Himiko did choose an empty room 
because of what Kiyo said...

Are you saying she chose the middle room
by pure coincidence?

The culprit gambled on the middle room
being picked through coincidence?
That seems highly improbable.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, that is true...
The culprit wouldn't have left that to chance.

<CLT=cltMIND>But maybe they didn't.
Perhaps they manipulated Himiko somehow.

However...there are three empty rooms.
Which one shall we use?

Um...the middle room. The middle 
room's always best for stuff like this.
No more...

I told you...it's too much of a pain.
Just do the voting or whatever...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko...

I'm pretty sure it didn't matter which room
Himiko chose...
What do you mean?
It's getting kinda boring, so I'll explain.

She didn't choose the middle by coincidence.
Each room was the same to begin with.
Each room...same?

Remember what Gonta said earlier? Maybe the
culprit placed traps in all the rooms?

Well...that was correct! Before the trial,
I hurt myself checking all the rooms.
Ah! That's right!

I guess...there was no crosspiece supporting
this floorboard, so I kinda...stepped through...
Ah-haha, what bad luck...

Kokichi found another <CLT=cltSTRONG>loose floorboard<CLT=cltNORMAL>
in one of the other rooms!

It's just like Gonta said. Each room
was the same. They were all trapped.
What? Is that true!?
Kokichi will tell you.

I was waaay too careless!
Eh, wait. What are you talking about?

I guess...there was no crosspiece supporting
this floorboard, so I kinda...stepped through...
Ah-haha, what bad luck...

While you were in the room next to the crime
scene, you found a <CLT=cltSTRONG>loose floorboard<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

Well...I didn't find it so much as I
stepped through it and tripped.

Whaaa—! Hold on! There was also a 
loose floorboard in the next room?

So the culprit prepared a trap in <CLT=cltSTRONG>all three
empty rooms<CLT=cltNORMAL>, not just the middle one.

If the culprit set traps in all the rooms, then
they wouldn't need to select a room themselves.

So the real trap was for someone else
to pick a room and take the blame!

I see... We were caught in the
culprit's trap all along.
Especially you!

But now there's no reason to suspect
Himiko! Right!?
Himiko...do you remember what Tenko told you?

Keep your chin up and live life facing forward! 
Survive with me and everyone else!
...Please.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>"Live life facing forward."<CLT=cltNORMAL>
She said that to you, right?

If you give up on living...
you'd be betraying her memory.

We're...all trying to
keep our promises to the dead.

This trial... It's not just for our lives,
it's for everyone who's died as well.

That's why we can't give up!
This is our responsibility! We live on!

You're...right.
Yeah... That's right...

If I gave up here, I wouldn't be able
to face Angie or Tenko...

That's right!
So let's do our best!

Nyeeeeeeh! Alright! I'm not gonna say
it's a pain anymore!

I won't give up! I'll fight alongside 
everyone and survive!

Do not say "everyone." After all, the
blackened is still among us.

Geez. There you go killing 
the mood like usual.

But damn! Well said, Shuichi!
That's what I'd expect from my soul bro!
Your..."soul bro"?

Well anyway, do you think the blackened
this time has some sort of superpower?
...What are you talking about?

Well, as a self-proclaimed expert
of stepping through floorboards...

Isn't it weird that no one stepped through
that floorboard before the culprit used it?
Ah... That is a good point.
It must've been barrier magic!

Well...that's one possibility... But I
think it might've been something else.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did no one step on the floorboard
until it was used for the murder...

<CLT=cltMIND>...Ah! That's it!
That must be the reason!

The culprit put the cage somewhere
that it wouldn't be touched by us!

Non, non. We carried that iron cage with
our sweat and tears!

Don't be mean, Shuichi.
You're really gonna ignore all my hard work?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Was the crosspiece supporting the
floorboard the whole time?

Maybe the culprit removed the crosspiece
right before stomping on the floorboard.

Hmmm, you think so? It would've been smarter
if they made sure no one stepped on it.

If the culprit adds more to the plan, 
then it'll become easier to screw up.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Umm... It's kind of hard to imagine
if you didn't participate in the seance...

You were part of the seance, right
Shuichi? Do you remember anything?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
That doesn't seem like it's related...

Shuichi, when you were preparing the 
seance, was there a spot you didn't step?

That could've been where the 
floorboard trap was hidden.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Why did no one step on the floorboard
until the culprit used it in the murder?

It's because of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic circle<CLT=cltNORMAL>
at the scene of the crime.

Also, it's dark in here, so be sure 
to watch your step.

If the magic circle is broken,
not only will the seance fail...
But it may also unleash a curse.

Before we began the seance, we were
warned not to step on the circle.

The floorboard in question was within the
circle. That's why no one stepped on it.

So the magic circle's purpose was to keep
us away from the whole trick.
That was part of the culprit's plans, too?

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right!
If that's the case, then the culprit...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no doubt in my mind.
They're the one who killed Tenko.

<CLT=cltMIND>Only one person had the
opportunity and the motive.

Himiko...
It really was y—

You know it's not me!
This is no time to mess around!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I already know who the culprit is, but I wanna
hear it from Mister Detective himself!
Obviously...you know already, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It can't be that person, can it, Shuichi?

Think about the magic circle and its purpose.
Whoever drew it is suspicious, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Who killed Tenko?
Kiyo...was it you?

Hmm? Whatever are you
talking about?
I'm talking about Tenko's murder.
Huh? Kiyo?
Why do you suspect me?

Because you were the one who
drew the magic circle.

The circle kept us from discovering
the seesaw trick...
But that's not all it was for.
In order to make the murder succeed...

...variables, like Tenko's position and the
placement of the cage, needed to be defined.

And those variables were defined by using
the magic circle.

In short, the circle itself was the most
important tool in this murder.

Knowing that, the person who drew
the magic circle has to be the culprit!
Well, Kiyo?
A-Answer already! Did you do it!?
Kehe...kehehehe...
Kehehehehehehehehe...
...What is so funny?
I was just thinking...

So this is how each blackened must have felt.
What an intriguing experience this is.
What? An intriguing experience?

But if I am the culprit as you claim,
then I stomped on the floorboard, yes?
So...do tell.

How could I have stomped on the
floorboard during that darkened seance?
I see... That is problem.

Kehehe... Unless that is made clear,
you cannot be certain I am the culprit.

How can you be so calm when you're
backed into a corner like this?

I will explain that in due time.
Please answer my question first.

<CLT=cltMIND>The culprit stepped on that exact
floorboard, even in the darkness...

<CLT=cltMIND>But how? How did they
move around in total darkness?

<CLT=cltMIND>In a room that dark, it's hard to imagine
the culprit found the right board.

<CLT=cltMIND>Although, even after I put out the candle,
I could move along the wall with my hand—
Wait a minute, maybe...
...Did you figure it out?

<CLT=cltMIND>That's it... The culprit didn't
even have to see at all. They used...
Hearing
The culprit used their hearing!

I don't think there were any other
sounds besides the song and the stomp.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Touch
Smell
The culprit used their sense of smell!

Wha-?
Was there anything that smelled?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Sixth sense

Perhaps the culprit saw beyond the
material plane... A sixth sense...

What are you saying at a time like this?
Do you want to die?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You said wait, but you don't have anything
figured out, do you?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>How did the culprit find
the seesaw in the darkness?

The culprit used <CLT=cltSTRONG>touch<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
They didn't see, they felt.

That way, they could get around in the dark.
Like how I got to the candle!

Wasn't seesaw in <CLT=cltSTRONG>middle of room<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Gonta doesn't think it was near wall.

So they probably used something
besides the wall to move then, right?

Hm? Were there any other markers within
reach?

Of course the answer to that is,
"There was nothing of the sort."
<CLT=cltMIND>No, I'm sure there was something.

<CLT=cltMIND>A landmark they could have used
to determine where the floorboard was.

<CLT=cltMIND>It must have been at the scene.
I know it.
